mapper.insert: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.PaymentMapper.ready */ INSERT INTO PAYMENT ( PAID_ID, ORDER_ID, BOOKED_NUMBER, AMOUNT, STATUS, SHOW_ID, SHOW_DATE_ID, SEAT_COUNT, SEAT_NAMES, SEAT_IDS ) VALUES ( #{paidId}, #{orderId}, #{orderId}, #{amount}, 'READY', #{showId}, #{showDateId}, #{seatCount}, #{seatNames}, #{seatIds} )
mapper.select: /* com.heeji.picket.mapper.PaymentMapper.infoByOrderId */ SELECT PAYMENT_ID AS paymentId , PAID_ID AS paidId , ORDER_ID AS orderId , PAYMENT_KEY AS paymentKey , BOOKED_NUMBER AS bookedNumber , AMOUNT AS amount , STATUS AS status , SHOW_ID AS showId , SHOW_DATE_ID AS showDateId , SEAT_COUNT AS seatCount , SEAT_NAMES AS seatNames , SEAT_IDS AS seatIds , PAID_DATE AS paidDate , CANCELED_DATE AS canceledDate , CANCEL_REASON AS cancelReason , METHOD AS method , PG_CODE AS pgCode FROM PAYMENT WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

/* com.heeji.picket.mapper.PaymentMapper.infoForCancel */ SELECT P.PAYMENT_ID AS paymentId , P.PAID_ID AS paidId , P.ORDER_ID AS orderId , P.PAYMENT_KEY AS paymentKey , P.BOOKED_NUMBER AS bookedNumber , P.AMOUNT AS amount , P.STATUS AS status , P.CANCELED_DATE AS canceledDate , SH.TITLE AS title , SD.SHOW_DATE AS showDate , DATE_SUB(SD.SHOW_DATE, INTERVAL 3 DAY) AS cancelableDate , CASE WHEN NOW() < DATE_SUB(SD.SHOW_DATE, INTERVAL 3 DAY) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS cancelable FROM PAYMENT P LEFT JOIN SHOWS SH ON SH.SHOW_ID = P.SHOW_ID LEFT JOIN SHOW_DATE SD ON SD.SHOW_DATE_ID = P.SHOW_DATE_ID WHERE P.BOOKED_NUMBER = #{bookedNumber} AND P.PAID_ID = #{userId}
